assertions.statement: A successful Xianyu shipment atomically creates or reuses a physical Delivery, binds its devices, and enqueues subscribe and initial-query tasks without waiting for Kuaidi100.
Kuaidi100 mapping, configuration, or network failure never rolls back an already successful Xianyu shipment and produces an explicit local tracking state.
One order supports multiple independent outbound, return, exchange-out, and exchange-return packages, and one package supports multiple devices without duplicate relations.
Provider calls execute outside business database transactions through leased idempotent Outbox workers.
A verified callback is persisted idempotently before acknowledgement and is processed asynchronously under the located tenant.
Identical complete tracking snapshots are suppressed, corrected histories advance versions, and late data cannot regress terminal status.
The schedule center batch-loads local tracking summaries, renders single and multiple packages, and loads full traces only on demand.
Manual refresh enqueues an asynchronous query or returns a stable throttled response with the next allowed time and never performs a synchronous provider query.
The visible schedule page polls only local summaries every 60 seconds, pauses while hidden, and refreshes immediately when visible again.
Logistics risks are server-derived and visible in the exception center without automatically releasing or changing device lifecycle state.

Provider credentials, tracking phone, callback secrets, callback payloads, full waybills, addresses, and phone numbers are encrypted or masked and never leak through logs, errors, metrics, tests, or ordinary UI.
Every logistics table, unique key, query, callback, worker, configuration, and operation is tenant-isolated.
Kuaidi100 SDK types remain inside the provider adapter and ordinary CI performs no real provider network access.
The additive migration succeeds on a fresh schema and current upgrade path without changing existing shipment or order values.
Historical backfill and technical-data cleanup are explicit permissioned operations and never run inside structural migration or automatically call the real provider.
The complete logistics UI passes light and dark, zh-CN and en, desktop and narrow-screen, loading, empty, permission, failure, multi-package, and delivered sensory coverage.

Each tenant can configure multiple encrypted Kuaidi100 credential pairs; a Delivery stably reuses its bound usable credential and safely reselects only when that credential is disabled, deleted, incomplete, cross-tenant, or for another Provider.
